text:
Glad it's done. It's 2 AM, so it makes sense you're tired. Get some sleep.

One small thing to look at when you're rested: Assessment 1 (the mutation model) falls at the end of Week 1, but mutations aren't formally taught until Week 3. You could cover point mutations and frameshifts briefly in Week 1, since they follow naturally from translation, or move that assessment later. It's a quick fix.

Good luck with the unit!
